1 minute of sumo deadlift high pulls  
1 minute of GHD sit-ups, **to parallel**  
1 minute of push presses  
1 minute of GHD sit-ups, **to parallel**  
Rest 1 minute  

Men: **75 lb.**  
Women: **55 lb.**   

**Beginner Option**  
3 rounds of:  
1 minute of sumo deadlift high pulls  
1 minute of **sit-ups**  
1 minute of push presses  
1 minute of **sit-ups**  
Rest 1 minute  

Men: **45 lb.**  
Women: **35 lb.**
